children: New Zealand and Brazil have agreed to establish a dialogue mechanism to promote trade and investment between the two countries, Trade Minister Todd McClay said in an email statement. According to Sina Finance, the dialogue will explore ways to deepen broader trade ties, including through trade negotiations, and support closer cooperation in areas such as World Trade Organization reform. The arrangement followed a meeting between senior New Zealand and Brazilian officials in Brasilia in September.

title: New Zealand and Brazil Agree to Dialogue to Promote Trade and Investment
